summary: DeFi Technologies Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing the appointment of Russell Starr as Strategic Advisor. Starr previously served as CEO and Head of Capital Markets at the company. The appointment is a routine strategic advisory role, not a forced or abrupt management departure. No terms, consideration, or premium were disclosed. This is a standard advisory engagement with no transactional or structural mechanics. The filing is a foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16. As it lacks event-driven special-situation features, it is classified as a management change, but with medium confidence due to the advisory nature.
